title: Human Catalog — Part History
description: A parts catalog for the history of our species: 775 parts from 300,000 years ago to 2026, filed by era, span, year line and system the way a car-parts catalog files by make, model and year. Includes 42 open questions specialists cannot yet answer (back-ordered parts), migration routes, idea threads and two learning games. Every part cites a source and was re-checked by an independent referee pass. Browse it at hashirama1337s.github.io/human-catalog.
